The CareIQ Scheduling Coordinator provides administrative customer service assistance to claimants, providers, and claims management by scheduling ancillary healthcare appointments. Utilizing proprietary systems and knowledge from training, a CareIQ Scheduling Coordinator will provide excellent telephonic and written customer service to both inbound and outbound customers. This role operates with a high focus on accuracy and urgency to ensure that appointments are scheduled quickly in alignment with the claimant and customer needs.

This is a remote position but for continuity of business with our management team, candidate needs to reside and work in the Central or Eastern time zones. A wired connection to your modem from a broadband internet network with a minimum bandwidth of at least 3 Mbps is required for this position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILTIES:

  • Provides telephonic customer service in an inbound and outbound high-volume call-center environment
  • Completes accurate data review and entry
  • Able to learn and operate corporate proprietary systems
  • Schedules medical appointments for claimants and owns the results of assigned cases, to ensure product service level expectations are met
  • Ensures all case stakeholders are updated regularly
  • Types and proofreads reports and correspondence via email and management systems
  • Transcribes correspondence/reports from dictation
  • Uses problem solving and critical thinking skills to ensure that daily scheduling challenges do not cause delays in securing appointments
  • Meets departmental production and quality performance expectations
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to meet designated deadlines
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office and Proprietary Systems
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to maintain a professional and courteous demeanor that sets tone for complex telephonic conversations
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • High School diploma
  • Prior work experience in a detail-oriented customer service environment

Description

Liberty Mutual Surety is currently recruiting for a Senior Surety Underwriter to join ourSmall to Mid Commercial Surety team in Florida.

As a Senior Surety Underwriter you will develop and underwrite profitable surety business, and service independent agents, brokers,and Small to Mid Commercial accounts within an assigned territory. Using your excellent relationship skills, you will build and maintain positive partnerships our agents, brokers, and accounts as a trusted advisor and underwriting resource for our producers and customers. You will also use yourbusiness and financial acumen to perform primary credit underwriting and financial/risk analysis, provide recommendations, and make decisions on new and existing accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced andself-motivated surety professional looking to grow their career with a top surety company that focuses on its employees and customers first.


Liberty Mutual Surety, a business unit of Liberty Mutual Insurance, is the worlds largest globally Surety, including in the United States. Conducting business worldwide through fronting relationships and Liberty-owned subsidiaries, we provide bonds in over 60 countries for construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers, and commercial enterprises on an account and transactional basis. We are committed to building mutually profitable relationships by providing smart business solutions, ease of doing business, and consistent, responsive service. Liberty Mutual Surety is dedicated to the communities we serve and highly values a diverse workforce in more than 18 countries.

Responsibilities:

  • Underwrite and negotiate accounts to maximize profitability whilst minimizing risk, which may include the most complex accounts based on level of role. Makes thorough evaluations and assessments of a customers financial, technical, organizational, and management capacities, including experience, desired objectives as well as a subjective judgment of character.
  • Manage the profitability and retention of an assigned book of business while continue to develop the portfolio through strong relationships and active engagement with new and existing agents and brokers. May assist in developing the marketing plan.
  • Performs analytical evaluations of financial statements on both a static and trend basis. Determines the present and historical financial position of accounts and monitors financial position of risk through analysis of quarterly statements and work in progress data as appropriate.
  • Stay abreast of Liberty Mutual Surety and Global Risk Solutions product lines and identify/promote opportunities across with agents and brokers, leveraging domestic and global capabilities.
  • Responsible for investigation, analyzing, and managing all necessary underwriting/accounting/workflow issues, within framework ofSurety policies and procedures.
  • May assess and identify changes in all aspects of the business including, but not limited to, work program to financial strength criteria, nature of work performed (inherent risk), accuracy and timeliness of data flow, and exposure analyses. Coordinate and surface issues to Home Office Underwriters and Field Management.
  • Assists in the evaluation of business continuity arrangements and funding mechanisms (such as adequacy of life insurance) to preclude financial drain of customer in the event of the demise of (an) owner or other insurable loss.
  • May mentor more junior staff based on level.
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.

If the selected candidate lives within 50 miles of a GRS office, then the selected candidate should be prepared to come into the office two days/week, but this is subject to change.

Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of surety UW experience and/or other related experience
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable Surety business

Job Description

Florida Blue 2027 IT Summer Internship Program

Florida Blue's Remote IT Summer Internship program is designed to give college juniors, seniors, and graduate students a hands-on look at our business processes and the tech systems that power them. You'll work on real projects, get on-the-job training, and partner with a mentor from your track-specific team.

In addition to your daily responsibilities, you'll have opportunities to:

  • Meet with leaders from all domains within the Tech organization
  • Engage with Executive Tech Leadership throughout the program
  • Present to Florida Blue's CIO and Tech Vice Presidents at the program's conclusion

We pride ourselves on a culture that values flexibility, innovation, and diversity. Bring your unique talents and help us advance our mission of helping people and communities achieve better health.

Read more about the tracks offered below and the qualifications/requirements for each.

Generative AI

You'll dive deep into the world of applied generative AI at GuideWell — working hands-on with enterprise AI platforms to design, build, and deploy solutions that solve real business problems. From prompt engineering and agentic workflows to tool integrations and responsible AI practices, you'll collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to bring AI capabilities to life across the organization.

To succeed in this role, you'll need:

  • A strong foundation in how large language models work, including prompting techniques, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic/tool-use patterns
  • Experience with LLM APIs and application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, or similar orchestration tools); experience with open-source or commercial models is a plus
  • Proficiency in Python; familiarity with ML/DL frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus but not required
  • Data manipulation and statistical analysis skills
  • Curiosity about responsible and effective AI adoption — how to evaluate, govern, and scale AI solutions in a business setting, not just build them
  • A passion for generative AI that drives you to push boundaries and explore new possibilities

A background in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science, Mathematics/Statistics, etc. is preferred.

Infrastructure

As an Infrastructure intern, you'll help in the development and implementation of policies and procedures to safeguard our company data, databases, and information systems. You'll be the one who keeps our technology secure, efficient, and running at peak performance.

To succeed in this role, you'll need:

  • A knack for designing, implementing, and troubleshooting technology
  • Experience in monitoring and maintaining complex systems
  • A passion for keeping our digital kingdom safe and secure
  • The skills to develop and implement policies that protect our tech assets

Basic skills/experience:

  • Knowledge or experience with AI platforms, LLMs, or supporting AI infrastructure/integrations is a plus
  • Knowledge of Linux commands and understanding of how to work with Linux boxes
  • Basic understanding of OpenShift and Kubernetes

Cloud Engineering

As a Cloud Services intern, you'll delve into the world of infrastructure as code, networking, automation, data storage, and security, using industry-leading platforms like Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure.

To succeed in this role, you'll need:

  • A curious and adventurous spirit, always eager to learn and explore
  • A willingness to take on new challenges and push the boundaries of what's possible
  • A passion for cloud computing and its endless possibilities
  • The drive to stay ahead of the curve and master the latest cloud technologies
  • Experience with AWS or Azure is preferred

Cybersecurity

As a Cybersecurity intern, you'll have the chance to work alongside the best in the business, tackling real-world challenges and projects that make a real difference.

You'll be part of a top-notch cybersecurity organization, collaborating with highly skilled red-team and blue-team members who are experts in their field. Together, you'll take on the toughest security challenges, using your skills and knowledge to outsmart cyber threats and protect our digital assets. You'll explore multiple security frameworks, stay ahead of the curve, and work on developing a deep understanding of information security concepts, principles, and solutions.

To succeed in this role, you'll need:

  • A passion for cybersecurity and a desire to make a real impact
  • A strong foundation in information security principles and practices
  • The drive to stay ahead of cyber threats and protect our digital world
  • Interest in how AI-assisted tools are changing threat detection and response is a plus

Completed or in-progress certifications such as Security+, Network+, A+, and/or Linux+ preferred.

Data Analytics

As a Data Analytics intern, you'll work on real-world business problems and publicly available datasets, applying cutting-edge techniques like data wrangling, model development, and visualization.

You'll be focused on data analytics, business intelligence, and data quality assessment for Florida Blue, working to drive business growth and improve health outcomes.

To succeed in this role, you'll need to be:

  • Passionate and inquisitive, always seeking to learn and improve
  • A quick learner, able to adapt to new tools and techniques
  • An expert "Googler," able to find creative solutions to complex problems
  • Have basic skills in SQL, R, and/or Python

Data Science

As a Data Science intern, you will have the opportunity to work on real-world projects, collaborate with experienced data scientists and engineers, and contribute to the development of innovative data analytics solutions. Responsibilities include designing, developing, and deploying data analytics models and algorithms to solve business problems, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights.

Key skills required include knowledge of machine learning algorithms, deep learning techniques, data analysis, and visualization, as well as strong collaboration and communication skills.

To be successful in this role, you are required to be:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Computational Biology
  • Skilled in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL
  • Analytical, detailed, and able to work with large datasets
  • Taking high-level computer science and math courses, such as Data Structures and Algorithms, Calculus I, Probability and Statistics, Linear Algebra, Calculus II

Application Development

As an application developer, you'll have the chance to showcase your creative skills, leveraging your knowledge of web development, design, and programming to craft solutions that make a real impact.

You'll focus on developing new applications, exploring new technologies, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. You'll need excellent communication skills to collaborate with teams, gather requirements, and design solutions that meet business needs.

To succeed in this role, you'll need:

  • Strong programming skills in languages like Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, or Swift
  • Knowledge of database management systems such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL
  • Experience with version control systems like Git
  • Experience with front-end frameworks such as React or Angular
  • Familiarity with back-end frameworks such as Node.js
  • A finger on the pulse of current technology trends and a desire to stay ahead of the curve

Business Analyst

As a Business System Analyst intern, you'll define and document business requirements, as well as collaborate with software developers, product owners, and testers to bring innovative solutions to life.

You'll help with end-to-end capabilities and assist in guiding projects from concept to production deployment. With your troubleshooting skills, you'll identify and resolve application defects, ensuring that business and end-user needs are met.

To succeed in this role, you'll need:

  • A strong understanding of business operations and processes
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex problems into manageable parts
  • Experience with business analysis tools and techniques, such as use cases, user stories, and process mapping
  • Familiarity with software development methodologies, such as Agile and Waterfall
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Experience with SQL databases is preferred

Must Have's:

  • Currently enrolled in computer science, information technology, mathematics, psychology, or related degree program as a Junior or Senior student at an accredited college/university
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or better
  • Must be able to commit to working at least 30 hours a week
  • Basic PC skills required including working knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook)
  • Basic programming knowledge, JavaScript/HTML/CSS or other Object Oriented programming experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; team and collaboration-oriented
  • Work under minimal supervision and adapt to a dynamic, changing environment

  • Must be a creative and innovative thinker

What We Offer:
As a Florida Blue employee, you will be at the heart of GuideWell's vision – to lead the nation in transforming health through compassionate, connected, and technology-enabled care that delivers personalized value and empowered living.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and
  • A comprehensive wellness program


Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Hourly Pay Range: $24 - $38

Typical Hourly Pay Range: $24 - $30

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.
